@deskSetNodeVersionOld.description: Settings > Node: tag or sub-line on a node whose software is older than the minimum version the wallet works well with. {version} is a version number like 3.6.0.

deskSetNodePortNote: Check the address and the port (usually 3413).

@deskSetNodePortNote.description: Settings > Node: error under the node picker when the typed node does not answer.

deskSetNodeListNote: State from status.btlabs.uk, checked every few minutes. Latency as measured from this computer.

@deskSetNodeListNote.description: Settings > Node: footer under the node list. status.btlabs.uk is a web address and stays as is.

@deskSetNodeStartTitle.description: Dialog title before the local node program starts.

deskSetNodeStartDesc: A separate program syncs the Epic chain on this computer.

@deskSetNodeStartDesc.description: Start the local node dialog: description under the title.

deskSetNodeStartLine1: Downloads the whole chain: several GB of disk space and bandwidth.

@deskSetNodeStartLine1.description: Start the local node dialog: first bullet.

deskSetNodeStartLine2: The first sync takes hours. Until it is done the node shows Syncing.

@deskSetNodeStartLine2.description: Start the local node dialog: second bullet. "Syncing" is the node status word.

deskSetNodeStartLine3: The firewall may ask to allow the node program.

@deskSetNodeStartLine3.description: Start the local node dialog: third bullet.

@deskSetNodeStartButton.description: Start the local node dialog: primary button.

@deskSetNodeRowNotSetUp.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: not installed or never started.

@deskSetNodeRowStopped.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: switched off.

@deskSetNodeRowStarting.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: starting up.

@deskSetNodeRowSyncingPct.description: Status of the local node in the node picker while syncing. {percent} is a number with a percent sign, e.g. "42%".

@deskSetNodeRowStalled.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: sync stopped making progress.

@deskSetNodeRowFailed.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: could not run.

@deskSetNodeLocalInUse.description: Toast title after switching to the local node.

deskSetNodeLocalInUseText: It downloads the whole chain. Needs 5 GB free.

@deskSetNodeLocalInUseText.description: Toast text after switching to the local node.

@deskSetNodeLocalNode.description: Name of the node program on this computer, in the node picker and its field.

@deskSetNodeGroupComputer.description: Heading of the node picker group holding the local node.

@deskSetNodeGroupMine.description: Heading of the node picker group of nodes the user saved; also a name used in other texts.

@deskSetNodeGroupPublic.description: Heading of the node picker group of public nodes.

@deskSetNodeRemovedFromMine.description: Toast title after a node was removed from the saved nodes. The node address follows as text.

@deskSetNodeNotAnswering.description: Node picker: word on a typed address whose node does not answer.

@deskSetNodeAddToMine.description: Node picker: tooltip and screen reader label of the star button on a typed address.

@deskSetNodeServer.description: Settings > Node: row title, picker label and screen reader name.

deskSetNodeServerHint: The node the wallet reads the chain through and sends with.

@deskSetNodeServerHint.description: Settings > Node: hint under the Node server row.

deskSetNodeFindHint: Find or type a node address

@deskSetNodeFindHint.description: Settings > Node: placeholder of the node picker search field.

@deskSetNodeChecking.description: Settings > Node: shown while a chosen node is checked.

deskSetNodeTypedNote: Enter uses it. The star keeps it in My nodes.

@deskSetNodeTypedNote.description: Settings > Node: note under a typed address in the picker. "Enter" is the keyboard key.

@deskSetNodeNoNodes.description: Settings > Node: empty note of the node picker.

@deskSetNodeFooterAdd.description: Node picker footer action that opens the add node dialog.

@deskSetNodeFooterDirectory.description: Node picker footer action that opens the node directory dialog.

@deskSetNodeBackground.description: Settings > Node: switch title and screen reader name.

deskSetNodeBackgroundHint: Keeps syncing while the app is closed.

@deskSetNodeBackgroundHint.description: Settings > Node: hint under Sync in background.
